notes.before: The peninsula’s northern crown, on firm ground above the rest of the landform, with substantial open Valmere water visible on every side. The compact two-by-three town marker shows a northwestern fort, dense roofs and a western harbour above the paired West/East Gate TOWN_ENTRANCE tiles at row 3 cols 7-8. The two-tile road meets only those gates. They lead to the separate Mornay town maps; returns land safely one row south at (240,144) and (272,144). South seam (cols 7-9) continues the road down to EASTERN_FENS_MORNAY_NECK_ROAD_MAP; west seam (rows 6-8) reaches the harbour shore; east seam (rows 10-12) reaches the exposed point. No overworld NPCs, items, interactions or encounter permission were added.
notes.after: The peninsula’s northern crown, on firm ground above the rest of the landform, with substantial open Valmere water visible on every side. The compact two-by-three town marker shows a northwestern fort, dense roofs and a western harbour above the paired West/East Gate TOWN_ENTRANCE tiles at row 2 cols 7-8. Water flanks both gates, restricting entry to the two-tile southern road. They lead to the separate Mornay town maps; returns land safely two rows south at (240,144) and (272,144). South seam (cols 7-9) continues the road down to EASTERN_FENS_MORNAY_NECK_ROAD_MAP; west seam (rows 6-8) reaches the harbour shore; east seam (rows 10-12) reaches the exposed point. No overworld NPCs, items, interactions or encounter permission were added.
